summary: Zombie Army entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Zombie Army Trilogy

primary.why: Sami chose PC; Windows is the highest-fidelity route, and published coverage associates the Left 4 Dead character roster addition with PC rather than a missing secondary port.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC version at max settings; confirm campaign chapters and roster content before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: This package bundles the first two Nazi Zombie Army campaigns with the third chapter; verify PC roster/content before capture.

entries.title: Zombie Army 4 Dead War
entries.definitive_edition: Windows Complete Edition or Windows base game with all owned DLC installed

emulation.notes: Native PC route; cloud and console builds are fallback access routes, not preservation primaries.

primary.version: Windows PC version with owned DLC installed
primary.why: Sami chose PC. Windows has the highest capture ceiling, while the sourced console/cloud/Switch routes do not add exclusive story or mission content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC build at max stable settings; verify Complete Edition or owned season-pass entitlements before treating the archive run as complete.

entries.remaster_caveats: Complete Edition and season-pass content are entitlement checks; confirm installed DLC, free packs, and campaign add-ons before final capture.

emulation.notes: Native VR build; headset choice is the practical fidelity limiter.

primary.why: Sami chose PC. Windows, Quest, and PS5/PS VR2 are supported; PC VR has the highest fidelity ceiling when headset and GPU are available.
primary.how_to_play: Use the SteamVR/PC VR build with the best available headset settings; use Quest or PS VR2 only if PC VR compatibility fails.
